channel.title: Hartford Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hartford Business Journal (hartfordbusiness.com)

item.title: Ryan Fazio campaign policy pitch promises cheaper electricity
item.description: In his first campaign news conference, Republican gubernatorial candidate Ryan Fazio outlined plans Monday to lower the high cost of electricity, asserting that Connecticut’s longstanding efforts to promote carbon-free energy have burdened ratepayers without mitigating climate change.

item.title: 🔒 Seasonal visa cap raised, but CT businesses must prove ‘irreparable harm’
item.description: The federal government has raised the cap on a visa program that’s commonly used by many seasonal businesses in Connecticut.

item.title: 🔒 Parent company of Bristol-based ESPN names new CEO
item.description: The parent company of Bristol-based ESPN, The Walt Disney Co., has named a new chief executive.

item.title: 🔒 Taxes, health care, workforce issues top business agenda as CT lawmakers convene
item.description: State lawmakers return to Hartford on Wednesday to open the 2026 legislative session and several issues that directly affect businesses will likely be on the agenda.

item.title: Downtown New Britain building sells for $1.64M to NY developer with rapidly growing CT portfolio
item.description: Downtown New Britain office building sells for $1.64 million to 28-year-old developer who plans to complete a stalled apartment conversion.

item.title: 🔒 Plainville retail plaza sells for $5.25M
item.description: A neighborhood retail center in Plainville has sold for $5.25 million.

item.title: Lobbying firms add veteran Capitol insiders ahead of legislative session
item.description: Two Connecticut lobbying firms have expanded their ranks with veteran Capitol insiders ahead of the 2026 legislative session.

item.title: 🔒 Norwalk-based Kayak names new CEO; co-founder Hafner to become executive chair
item.description: Norwalk-based online travel search company Kayak has appointed Peer Bueller as chief executive officer, replacing co-founder Steve Hafner, who will transition to executive chair after 22 years leading the travel search company.

item.title: CT eviction reform to anchor housing debate in 2026 session
item.description: A measure to require landlords to give a reason when they evict renters — a controversial proposal in housing policy — is likely to be center stage during the upcoming legislative session, key lawmakers and advocates said.

item.title: In major $12.3B deal, Webster Bank to be acquired by Santander Bank
item.description: Stamford-based Webster Financial Corp., a dominant player in Connecticut’s banking scene, has entered a deal to be acquired by Spain-based Banco Santander.
